verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials are a fair axis for a product with a hosted, key-authenticated inference API, so this applies. The evidence only shows browser sign-in that hands the terminal a credential, and key entitlement that varies by environment. Nothing documents issuing a key with restricted permissions, scopes, or least-privilege limits for an agent. Per-environment entitlement is a related but different behavior, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
